items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: My first wife -- her name was Selma Cord; Artie hired her as a singer

ctx.x: And Artie Shaw insisted on what he wanted in life, and he wanted Billie Holiday who was just as great then as the day she died. In order to come with our band, and we were doing ballrooms, Sy Schribman had the idea that Billie should come on as a single and they should have a white vocalist that sat on the bandstand, and perform with the band. And Billie would come on as a single and perform her bit.

My first wife -- her name was Selma Cord; Artie hired her as a singer, she had sung around the clubs in Boston, and she was very young but she had a good voice, [and her] and Pete gave her the name Nita Bradley. Now we were married, we were on the road with Artie Shaw, but
* Boston-based Ballroom owner and band leader.
